CREATE TABLE raw (ts BIGINT, site TEXT, device TEXT, tag TEXT, value DOUBLE, quality TEXT)
WITH (connector = 'kafka', bootstrap_servers = 'kafka:9092', topic = 'exp.l4.raw', type = 'source',
      format = 'json', 'source.offset' = 'latest');
CREATE TABLE alerts (ts BIGINT, site TEXT, device TEXT, tag TEXT, value DOUBLE, alert_type TEXT, severity TEXT,
      detector TEXT, detail TEXT)
WITH (connector = 'kafka', bootstrap_servers = 'kafka:9092', topic = 'exp.l4.alerts.arroyo', type = 'sink', format = 'json');
INSERT INTO alerts
SELECT ts, site, device, tag, value,
       CASE WHEN (tag = 'LT-101' AND value > 95.0) OR (tag = 'LT-102' AND value > 90.0) OR (tag = 'TT-101' AND value > 95.0) OR (tag = 'TT-102' AND value > 125.0) OR (tag = 'PT-101' AND value > 6.0) OR (tag = 'IT-101' AND value > 14.0) OR (tag = 'IT-102' AND value > 9.6) OR (tag = 'VT-101' AND value > 7.1) OR (tag = 'pH-101' AND value > 8.4) THEN 'THRESHOLD_USL' ELSE 'THRESHOLD_LSL' END AS alert_type,
       'CRITICAL' AS severity, 'TIER1_RULE' AS detector,
       concat(tag, ' = ', CAST(round(value, 3) AS TEXT), CASE WHEN tag = 'LT-101' THEN ' % / 규격 [10.0, 95.0]' WHEN tag = 'LT-102' THEN ' % / 규격 [15.0, 90.0]' WHEN tag = 'TT-101' THEN ' degC / 규격 [40.0, 95.0]' WHEN tag = 'TT-102' THEN ' degC / 규격 [-, 125.0]' WHEN tag = 'PT-101' THEN ' barg / 규격 [-, 6.0]' WHEN tag = 'IT-101' THEN ' A / 규격 [-, 14.0]' WHEN tag = 'IT-102' THEN ' A / 규격 [-, 9.6]' WHEN tag = 'VT-101' THEN ' mm/s / 규격 [-, 7.1]' WHEN tag = 'pH-101' THEN ' pH / 규격 [6.2, 8.4]' ELSE '' END) AS detail
FROM raw WHERE (tag = 'LT-101' AND (value > 95.0 OR value < 10.0)) OR (tag = 'LT-102' AND (value > 90.0 OR value < 15.0)) OR (tag = 'TT-101' AND (value > 95.0 OR value < 40.0)) OR (tag = 'TT-102' AND (value > 125.0)) OR (tag = 'PT-101' AND (value > 6.0)) OR (tag = 'IT-101' AND (value > 14.0)) OR (tag = 'IT-102' AND (value > 9.6)) OR (tag = 'VT-101' AND (value > 7.1)) OR (tag = 'pH-101' AND (value > 8.4 OR value < 6.2));

SELECT ts, site, device, tag, value, 'ZSCORE', 'WARNING', 'TIER1_ZSCORE', 'z' FROM (
  SELECT *, sum(viol) OVER (PARTITION BY tag ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS viol_run FROM (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN sd > 1e-9 AND abs(value - mu) / sd > 3.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS viol FROM (
      SELECT ts, site, device, tag, value,
        avg(value) OVER (PARTITION BY tag ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS mu,
        stddev(value) OVER (PARTITION BY tag ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sd,
        count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY tag ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n
      FROM raw) a WHERE n >= 30) b) c
WHERE viol_run >= 3;
